title: Comparing GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.1 alt-text outputs

Quarto document includes three figures: time-series US unemployment (fig-unemployment). bar chart average ozone month (fig-ozone-month). set density curves temperature month (fig-temp-density) goal “prove” one model universally better, show behave specific alt-text task justify sensible default choice.
